$comment: The standing mailbox pull request: a draft PR from lane/mailbox (one EMPTY commit, no file changes, never merged, never closed) whose comments wake the cloud lane's session at once. scripts/lane-deliver.mjs comments on it after every delivery when `gh` is on PATH, and prints its URL otherwise so a person can. The cloud lane subscribes to it (subscribe_pr_activity) at every session start and every steward cycle. Created 2026-09-05 in response to the owner's 'this is causing delay' — the alternative was the four-hour steward timer.
